renderedFields.description:
The Bug:

Barrier particles aren't shown if particles are set to minimal.

Steps to Reproduce:

  1. Set your particles to "minimal" in your video settings.
  2. Switch into creative mode and place down a barrier block.
  3. Take note as to whether or not barrier particles are shown if particles are set to minimal.

Observed Behavior:

Barrier particles aren't shown.

Expected Behavior:

Barrier particles would be shown.
